stories.title: ‘Buyers are out for blood’: With home sales at a record low, buyers are calling the shots
stories.summary: The few buyers left in the market braving record-high home prices and 7% mortgage rates are starting to call the shots, real-estate agents say.
stories.zh_title: 「買家熱血沸騰」：隨著房屋銷售創歷史新低，買家正在發號施令
stories.zh_summary: 房地產經紀人表示，市場上剩下的少數買家冒著創紀錄的高房價和 7% 的抵押貸款利率開始發號施令。

stories.title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020
stories.summary: Anthropic held its historic Nasdaq debut a day before Nvidia's stock closed out its longest weekly losing streak since 2008.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 創紀錄的 IPO 與華爾街科技股自 2020 年以來最糟糕的一周相撞
stories.zh_summary: 在英偉達股票結束自 2008 年以來最長的周線下跌前一天，Anthropic 歷史性地在納斯達克首次亮相。

stories.title: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
stories.summary: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup — in a trend that's already popular in China. Experts question the long-term consequences if this becomes a trend in Hollywood, too.
stories.zh_title: 向這家微劇新創公司出售人工智慧版本的臉會是好萊塢的未來嗎？
stories.zh_summary: 一名演員將自己的臉授權給一家微劇新創公司——這一趨勢在中國已經很流行。如果這也成為好萊塢的趨勢，專家質疑其長期後果。

stories.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
stories.summary: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.
stories.zh_title: Signal 限制行動螢幕截圖，因為它面臨人工智慧監控的“生存威脅”

stories.title: A tale of two Nvidias
stories.summary: We got two very different pictures of Nvidia — the company’s latest earnings report vs. the tech executives loudly calling for Jensen Huang’s return.
stories.zh_summary: 我們看到了英偉達的兩個截然不同的景象——該公司最新的盈利報告與大聲呼籲黃仁勳回歸的科技高管。

stories.title: The Outages Are Just Getting Started
stories.summary: AI is forcing companies to patch their systems faster as attackers race to exploit newly discovered vulnerabilities. Welcome to internet outage hell.
stories.zh_summary: 隨著攻擊者競相利用新發現的漏洞，人工智慧正迫使公司更快修補系統。歡迎來到網路中斷地獄。
